summary: Retest of the iteration_121 follow-up fixes. Backend: 11 passed + 1 known xfail (new tests/test_round3_lock_iter122.py + regression test_round3_fixes_iter121.py). The GET estimate locked flag works: EST-1041 has locked=true for owner and sales, a new estimate has locked=false, and accepting a quote sets locked=true and PUT returns 409. Owner and sales (own lead) can edit and save unlocked estimates. UI on EST-1041, owner and sales: estimate-locked-note shows; the fieldset, desc/qty/sell inputs, remove, tax rate, Save and Add item are disabled; fill is blocked; remove does nothing; takeoff-locked shows (office-only hidden). ONE GAP: the unit Select (Radix) still opens on a real mouse click while locked. Picking 'EA' changes the unit and shows 'Unsaved changes' (Save stays disabled and the backend 409s, so no data risk). Re-measure scenario (TEST lead, rev1 2000sf applied, rev2 2600sf verified): Advanced changed-metrics shows 'roof squares: 20 → 26', 'roof area sqft: 2000 → 2600', and object metrics show 'changed'. The waste notice reads 'Same 10.00% waste on a changed roof area (+0.60 squares of waste material).' I could not make a null metric value, so the '— → x' rendering was checked by code review only (c.from ?? '—'; null is guarded before the typeof-object check). Regression: lead → New estimate → custom line (4 x $25) → Save → reload persists → Create proposal → /quotes/{id}/proposal QUO-0967, $100. Sales on own lead: edit price + tax → save → reload persists ($42.00).

ui_bugs.issue: Radix <Select> ignores the native fieldset disabled. A real mouse click on el-unit-{i} opens the listbox while the estimate is locked, and choosing an option changes the unit and shows 'Unsaved changes'. Fix: pass disabled={!editable} to <Select> (or to SelectTrigger).

issues: The unit list shows both 'sq' and 'SQ' (and ea/EA) because the line unit is merged with UNITS without case normalization
The tax rate value text looks faded/grey even when enabled (sales own estimate)

Locked estimate: 'Create proposal' / 'Create new proposal' stays enabled. This is probably intended, but for sales on EST-1041 the hint just says 'A proposal from this estimate was accepted.' next to an enabled Create proposal button

action_items: Add disabled={!editable} to the line unit <Select> in EstimateEditor.jsx (line ~278)
Optional: dedupe the unit options case-insensitively
critical_code_review_comments: _out calls _has_accepted_quote per estimate. If the list endpoint uses _out, that is one extra query per row (N+1). Fine at the current scale.
Leads have no DELETE (405), so TEST_ leads from tests stay in the DB
